notes_meta.calendar: Week calendar. Wed Oct 28: Fed decision, Microsoft and Alphabet (after close), Oracle Investor Day (10:55am CT) and Apple's Los Angeles event. Thu Oct 29: Amazon (2pm PT), Intel (2pm PT) and Sandisk (4:30pm ET). Mon Nov 2: Apple (2pm PT) and Palantir (after close). Tue Nov 3: AMD (2pm PT), Astera (4:30pm ET), Lam's annual meeting and Snowflake Expedition (Nov 3–5). Wed Nov 4: Arm and Qualcomm (1:45pm PT). Thu Nov 5: MP Materials. Mon Nov 10: IBM ex-dividend. Pending, no date: the Qualcomm v. Arm royalty ruling. Chart picture: a risk-on day. SOFI +13.4% (on results), ALAB +10.5%, MP +9.1%, AMD +5.5%, TSLA +4.0% to a four-month high, AVGO +4.0% and MRVL +4.2%. TSLA and SOFI broke out above their 20-day highs. META closed below its 20-day low and 200-day for a third day on its upsized equity raise, and GOOG held below its 20-day low into tonight's print. GOOG (RSI 22), ALAB and SNDK (22), ARM (23) and META (24) are the most oversold; IBM (82) is the most extended. Gaps: most articles could not be opened, so items are headline only; Robinhood's after-hours figure and SoFi's close are early quotes. IBKR closes match the news pages for all names that gave a usable close.
